maitrise-farming.x: See also: [[crop|Crop]] for the list of all crops.

Farming is one of the [[masteries|masteries]] that involves the player growing [[crop|crop]]s on their farm. The player can then sell the crops they have harvested, process them into [[artisan-product|artisan products]], [[cooking|cook]] with them or [[gift|gift]] them.

The Farming mastery pertains to all things having to do with tilling and watering the soil, and harvesting the produce. The farming proficiency is increased as the player gain level in their farming mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.

The player can increase their farming mastery level by doing activities below. Tilling soil using bomb or watering soil using sprinkler do not provide points. However, harvesting using sprinklers attachment does provide points although it is seemed not triggering learned skill such as Quality Crop or Double Crop.
Note in this section crops refer to plants from seeds, fruit plants refer to plants from seedling, and fruit tree refer to plants from sapling.

r: Harvesting a [[crop|crop]], [[fruit-plant|fruit plant]], or [[fruit-tree|fruit tree]] for the first time*
Harvesting a new [[crop|crop]], [[fruit-plant|fruit plant]], or [[fruit-tree|fruit tree]] for the first time*

maitrise-farming.x: *To elaborate more on table above refer to example: Player harvests regular turnip for the first time. Player earns 25 farming points for harvesting crop for the first time, player also earns 25 farming points for harvesting turnip as a new crop for the first time, as well as earning 3 farming points because regular turnip's price is 40 or. Afterward player harvests regular daisy for the first time. Player earns 25 farming points for harvesting daisy as a new crop for the first time, as well as earning 3 farming points because regular daisy's price is 40 or.
Reaching a new level in farming mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.

Every other level of farming mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills by leveling up. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|farming elixir]].

r: 25% chance for watered soil to stay watered the following day.
10% chance for crops to grow faster.
15% increase to the selling price of all crops. (In-game description is not accurate, refer to [[sell-price|Sell price]])
10% chance to leave a seed behind when clearing crops (harvesting or destroying).

maitrise-farming.x: The higher the player's farming level is, the less energy it costs to use [[hoe|hoe]] and [[watering-can|watering can]]. Using [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|farming proficiency buff]] can temporarily further reduce the stamina cost.

maitrise-ranching.x: Ranching is a one of the [[masteries|masteries]] that involves petting [[farm-animal|farm animals]] and collecting their products. The player can raise animals after building a [[coop|coop]] or a [[barn|barn]]. The animals can be purchased at the local [[ranch|ranch]].

The Ranching mastery pertains to all things having to do with petting animals and collecting their products. The ranching proficiency is increased as the player gain level in their ranching mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.

The player can increase their ranching mastery level by spend their time on farm animal-related activities. Using [[auto-petter|Auto petter]] and [[auto-collector|Auto collector]] currently don't provide any points and are seemed to not trigger any learned skills.

r: Collecting animal product of regular quality
Collecting animal product of bronze quality
Collecting animal product of silver quality
Collecting animal product of gold quality
Collecting animal product of osmium quality

maitrise-ranching.x: Reaching a new level in ranching mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] or [[cooking|cooking]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.

Every other level of ranching mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills by leveling up. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|ranching elixir]].

r: 25% chance for animal feed to stay filled the next day.
10% chance to harvest better-quality animal products.
5% chance to harvest double animal products.
5% increase in rate to befriend animals.
15% Increase to the selling price of all animal products. (also includes all cheese except fermented cheese, all mayonnaise, all wool and yarn, and all truffle oil)
10% chance to increase the size of animal products.

maitrise-ranching.x: The main tools used for ranching are the [[milk-pail|milk pail]] for collecting [[milk-group|milk]] from [[cow|cow]]s and [[goat|goat]]s and the [[shears|shears]] for collecting [[wool|wool]] from [[sheep|sheep]] and [[llama|llama]]s. Consuming items with [[buff|ranching proficiency buff]], will temporarily improve milk pail and shears proficiency. Unlike other masteries, it is seemed that proficiency in ranching does not have any effect since using the tools don't consume stamina.

maitrise-foraging.x: Foraging, also called scavenging or gathering, is one of the [[masteries|masteries]] that involves the player gathering items in the wild on Coral Island and cutting [[trees|trees]]. The player can use the items for various things, from [[gift|gift]]s to [[cooking|cooking]] to selling them for money.
Foraging mastery

The player can increase their foraging mastery level by cutting down trees and regularly gathering items on the island. Most of these actions give the player foraging experience; as the player obtains more experience, their foraging mastery level improve, allowing them to unlock new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes and useful skills.
Experience

The player's actions that depend on and increase their foraging mastery level are detailed below. Foraging [[diving|ocean scavengables]] will only give [[diving|diving]] experience. Destroying trees using bombs will also provide points. Note that these are referring to [[trees|trees]] growth state and not referring to [[fruit-plant|fruit plants]] or [[fruit-tree|fruit trees]]. Gathering [[coconut-group|any coconut]] will not provide foraging points.

r: Cutting a tree seed, sprout, or seedling (baby tree)
Cutting a large log (in the farm)

maitrise-foraging.x: Levels
Reaching a new level in foraging mastery grants the player new crafting recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.
Skills

Every other foraging mastery level gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills by leveling up. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|foraging elixir]].

r: 10% chance to forage better-quality items. (Only affects land forageable items.)
2% chance for regular trees to drop [[hardwood|hardwood]]. · Only regular fully mature [[trees|trees]] get a small chance to drop one hardwood in addition to their regular drops.
15% increase to the selling price of all foraged goods. (Only affects land forageable items, and includes all tree seeds, hay and fiber. )
10% lower process time for [[bee-house|bee house]]s and [[mushroom-log|mushroom log]]s

maitrise-foraging.x: Proficiency

The higher the player's foraging level is, the less energy it costs to use [[axe|axe]]. Using [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|gathering proficiency buff]] can temporarily further reduce the stamina cost.
Logging

Chopping wild trees and tree seedlings on the [[farm|farm]] and in the wild earns the player foraging experience and is affected by foraging skill. Only wild trees are affected, the five types of wild trees available are [[maple-tree|maple]], [[oak-tree|oak]], [[pine-tree|pine]], [[mahogany-tree|mahogany]], and [[poplar-tree|poplar]].
Spawning and locations

New forageable items can potentially appear overnight on the main island map. For item spawn purposes the map is divided into separate areas, with each area having its own limit on the number of items that can spawn there.
If left unharvested, the forageable items will disappear after a week.

The spawn limit in the table below denotes how many forageables can be present in an area before they stop spawning daily. If the limit is zero, that means no new forageables will spawn until all items present in the area are harvested or disappear.

maitrise-foraging.x: List of forageable items

The items available for scavenging on the island change depending on the current [[calendar|season]]. [[ocean|Ocean]] and [[beach|beach]] scavengables stay the same regardless of the season; additionally, there are several items available all year round.

Wild coconut palms growing on the island will bring harvest once per every season. The palms are only harvestable during specific dates and can be harvested once per season. When the player shakes a palm, they get 1-3 coconuts, with the variety of coconuts depending on the current season.
Picking up a scavengeable item in the wild or shaking a palm tree to harvest it consumes no [[energy|energy]].
All-season
Beach

These beach scavengeables can be gathered on the southern [[beach|beach]] or on the beach south of [[coral-inn|Coral Inn]] and east of the [[lighthouse|Lighthouse]] during any season. Currently shells have no specific use and can only be [[gift|gift]]ed, [[shipping-bin|shipped]], or sold at [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]].
Ocean
These items can be gathered on the ocean floor when [[diving|diving]]. Unlike land forageable items, they give diving experience when picked up.

maitrise-mining.x: Mining is the part of the gameplay where the player breaks rocks and gather ores, coal and [[gem|gem]]s from the rocks either on the farm or in the mine. Most of the materials are used for crafting, upgrading and building. There are nodes on the floor that create a path you have to hit to get ore out of.

The Mining mastery pertains to all things having to do with breaking stone and collecting gems and ores. The efficiency of the player's mining tools is increased as they gain proficiency in their mining mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.

The player can increase their mining mastery level by clearing stone on the island and in the mines. Breaking rare gem nodes yields the most experience, and in most cases, the more damage a kind of stone can take, the more mastery experience it brings. Using bombs to destroy the stones etc will still give the points.
Reaching a new level in mining mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] or [[cooking|cooking]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.

Every other level of mining mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills total. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|mining elixir]].

r: 10% chance to break surrounding rocks when mining.
100% increases to the chance of finding geodes.
1% chance for regular rocks to drop rare resources.
15% increase to the selling price of all gems. (and includes ores and bars)

maitrise-mining.x: The higher the player's mining level is, the less energy it costs to use [[pickaxe|pickaxe]]. Using [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|mining proficiency buff]] can temporarily further reduce the stamina cost.

maitrise-diving.x: Diving is the player’s ability to go underwater to clean up the trash and gain valuables from the sea. When diving, the player can find [[kelp|kelp]], , [[solar-fragment|solar fragments]] and other underwater scavenge items.
Diving is unlocked on the 8th day of Spring when the player receives a letter instructing to meet at the dock.
Diving mastery

The Diving mastery pertains to all things having to do with navigating, cleaning trash, and harvesting resources on the sea floor. The efficiency of the player's diving tools is increased as they gain proficiency in their diving mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.
Experience

The player can increase their diving mastery level by regularly spending their time on underwater activities like cleaning up trash in the ocean and gathering items on the ocean floor. Using Vortexanator to clear the debris will still provide points.
Levels
Reaching a new level in diving mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.
Skills

Every other level of diving mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills total. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing a [[diving-elixir|diving elixir]].

r: 2% chance for trash to drop rare resources.
100% increase to the chances of finding artifacts.
5% chance to receive double [[artifact|artifacts]] from artifact troves.
30% increase to the selling price of all artifacts. (in-game description is wrong, actually affect all ocean scavengables and kelps)

maitrise-diving.x: Tools

The main [[tool|tool]] used while diving is the [[scythe|scythe]], used for breaking up piles of trash and cutting patches of kelp and seaweed. The scythe consumes 3 [[energy|energy]] per successful hit of a breakable or harvestable object.

can also be used to quickly destroy trash found underwater, but lack the chance of activating mining skills. A [[pickaxe|pickaxe]] is required to destroy sandstone deposits on the ocean floor, but doesn't affect the Diving skill.
Tool efficiency

The higher the player's diving level is, the less energy it costs to use the scythe. Eating [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|Diving Proficiency buff]] can further reduce the stamina cost. The pickaxe is not affected.
Diving process

Once diving is unlocked, the player can start their dive anytime between 6:00 and 23:00 by interacting with the boat at the [[diving-pier|Diving Pier]]. The player will have a choice to return to the location they have left the anchor last time they dived or reset the start location.

When underwater, the player will need to clear [[trash|trash]] and debris on the ocean floor with their [[scythe|scythe]] to obtain resources and collect solar orbs. They can also catch underwater [[sea-critter|critter]]s with their [[bug-net|bug net]], cut seaweed, or collect that spawn on the ground.

When the player unearths a solar orb, they will need to activate it by picking it up and when clearing the way towards a pylon to heal nearby corals. Healing corals earns the player points Ocean, improves the quality of fish caught, and progresses one of the main [[quest|quest]]s of the game. It can also open previously inaccessible underwater areas by cleaning the oil from the environment.
The player can leave the underwater area by interacting with the anchor. The anchor can be moved by pressing X and waiting until it drops.
Ocean points
Ocean healing
[[waypoint|Waypoint]]s are unlocked when all the solar orbs in a certain area have been activated. They are located in front of ocean caves.
Orchestra sites
As part of the quest « Song of the Sea », the player must submit donations to heal orchestra sites.
Ocean Loot
Ocean scavengeables

Items found in the ocean stay the same regardless of the season, and instead change according to how deep underwater the player is. Unlike land forageable items, they give diving experience when picked up.
Ocean critters
Critters are animals the player can catch with their [[bug-net|bug net]] while diving. Critters can be sold or donated to the [[museum|museum]].
Trash and debris
Every trash or debris pile can drop items when destroyed (up to a maximum of 3 items per pile).

maitrise-catching.x: Catching is one of many activities available on Coral Island. Over 30 kinds of [[insect|insect]]s and [[sea-critter|critter]]s can be captured with [[bug-net|bug net]], documented, and donated to the [[museum|museum]]. This past-time was added to the game due to the [[kickstarter-campaign|Kickstarter campaign]] successfully meeting one of its early stretch goals.
Catching mastery

The Catching mastery pertains to all things having to do with catching [[insect|insects]] and [[sea-critter|ocean critters]] in the wild. The catching proficiency is increased as the player gain level in their catching mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.
Experience

The player can increase their catching mastery level by regularly spending their time catching insects and ocean critters. The more difficult an insect or critter is to catch, the more mastery experience it brings, with a bonus for the quality of the creature caught. Catching insects/critters using traps will also provide points and trigger skill if learned. Breeding insects through [[insect-house|insect house]] is also a good way to earn points even though lack of triggering learned skills.

r: Catching insect/critter with very hard difficulty

maitrise-catching.x: Levels
Reaching a new level in catching mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.
Skills

Every other level of catching mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills by leveling up. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|catching elixir]].

r: 10% slower awareness gain of insects and ocean critters.
5% chance to catch better-quality insects and ocean critters.
5% chance to catch double insects and ocean critters.
Increases movement speed while holding a net by 50%.
25% Increase to the selling price of all insects and ocean critters.

maitrise-catching.x: Proficiency

The higher the player's catching level is, the less energy it costs to use [[bug-net|bug net]]. Using [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|catching proficiency buff]] can temporarily further reduce the stamina cost.
Using bug net

Bug net can be obtained as early as on day 3 of the first year by completing « Visit the Beach Shack », and can be further upgraded. The upgraded nets cost the same amount of [[energy|energy]] to use but have increased catch angle and radius compared to the basic net.

To catch an insect or a critter, the player needs to approach it in the wild and swing their bug net using the left mouse button, aiming it so the insect is inside the net's catch area and is highlighted. If the player releases the button when the insect is highlighted, the insect is transferred to their [[inventory|inventory]].

All insects and critters will notice the player approaching, as shown with a circle alertness indicator above them. If the player fails to catch the creature before its circle indicator fills completely, the creature rapidly flees; it can still be caught while fleeing. The harder an insect or a creature are to catch, the faster it moves, the more easily it is alerted to the player's presence, and the faster its circle indicator fills.
All bug nets cost 20 energy to use if the player catches an insect or a critter or 1 energy if the swing fails.
Using traps

There are 4 types of catching traps in total. Traps can be placed on the ground on the land to attract [[insect|insects]] or in the ocean to attract [[sea-critter|critters]], and for each there are different traps to catch floating/flying catchable or crawling catchable.
Using scents
There are also 4 types of scents scents that can be used by consuming them or can be placed on the corresponding traps.

maitrise-fishing.x: watching]] Fishing is a game mechanic in Coral Island that allows the player to use a [[fishing-pole|fishing pole]] to catch [[fish|fish]] from a body of water. The fish caught can be used as an ingredient for [[cooking|cooking]], [[gift|gift]]ed to other characters, donated to the [[museum|museum]], or sold for [[coral-coin|money]].
Players can see which fish they have caught by viewing their [[journal|Journal]].
There are plans under deliberation to allow the player to disable fishing mini-games.
Fishing mastery

The fishing mastery pertains to all things having to do with catching [[fish|fish]]. The fishing proficiency is increased as the player gain level in their catching mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes or points to spend for new skill.
Experience

The player can increase their fishing mastery by catching fish in various bodies of water. The experience gained depends on the difficulty of the fish the player catches, with more difficult species giving more experience points, with a bonus for the quality of the fish caught. Breeding fish through [[fish-pond|fish pond]] is also a good way to earn points even though lack of triggering learned skills.

r: Catching fish with very easy difficulty
Catching fish with very hard difficulty

maitrise-fishing.x: Levels
Reaching a new level in fishing mastery sometimes grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.
Skills

Every other level of fishing mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills by leveling up. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|fishing elixir]].

r: 25% increase to the selling price of all fish.
3% chance for an instant pull while fishing.

maitrise-fishing.x: Proficiency

The higher the player's fishing level is, the less energy it costs to use the fishing pole. Using [[consumables|consumables]] that grant a [[buff|fishing proficiency buff]] can temporarily further reduce the stamina cost.
Fishing controls

Most bodies of water in the game can be fished from. Basic fishing is done by casting the end of the fishing line into a body of water. The player casts the fishing rod by holding the right mouse button, then releasing it; as the player holds down the button, their casting gauge fills. The higher the cast number when the player releases the button, the further the bobber will fly. Additionally, the cast length affects the player's chances to catch trash and rarer fish.

Once the line is cast, the player needs to wait until a fish bites. Once a fish bites, the fishing mini-game starts immediately. During the mini-game, the player's objective is to reel the fish in by holding or tapping the left mouse button while avoiding the tension to rise enough for the fish to snap the line. Once the player reels the fish in, they are shown what species it is and its size in centimeters, and the fish gets added to their [[inventory|inventory]].
Mechanics
Cast length

The length of the cast when fishing can influence the fish's rarity and size, as well as the odds of catching trash, and there is a constant small chance of catching a rare item like a geode or coffer. Quality of [[fishing-pole|fishing pole]] affects max cast length and some other parameters that affects fishing efficiency.
For most spawn locations, the distribution is:
*Example, if cast length is 6, the chance of getting common fish is ~19%. If cast length is 1, the chance of getting large fish is ~6.5%.
Trash and treasures
While fishing, there's still at least 5% chance to find [[trash|trash]] or [[flyer|flyer]] even at max cast length. There's also 0.05% chance to find treasure at any cast length.
Rarity of fish

So far rarity of fish can't be influenced during fishing. However, there are some variant of fish that can be fished in the mines with lower rarity compared to their regular counterpart. There are 4 rarity group:
Legendary fish will take 4 days to breed in [[fish-pond|fish pond]] while the rest will only take 2 days.
Size of fish
Cast length and bait can influence fish's size during fishing. There are 3 size group:
Bait

Bait can be attached to a fishing pole using the equipable slot for it in the player's inventory. Baits can be used to increase the chance catching different size of fish. Bait can be crafted or can also be purchased from the [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]].
Fish patterns
All fish are assigned one of a few possible swim patterns that can be observed when they're on the line. The pattern can be used to further narrow down the kind of fish that is on the hook.

maitrise-combat.x: ]] The player goes through combat during the fight against [[monster|monsters]]. Monsters can be found in the [[cavern|cavern]].

The player can fend off monsters using weapons. During combat, the player’s [[energy|Energy]] and [[health|Health]] can deteriorate when the monster hits the player. The player can regain them back by consuming food.
The player can increase their combat mastery level by killing monsters in the mines which give different points per kill depending on the [[monster|monsters]].
Reaching a new level in the combat mastery grants the player new [[crafting|crafting]] recipes when they go to sleep to end their day.

Every other level of combat mastery gained allows the player to unlock one skill. The player will be able to unlock up to five skills total. The last skill can be unlocked by purchasing [[merit-points|combat elixir]].

r: 20% more damage dealt by all weapons.
5% higher chance of a critical strike.
5% chance to receive double loot from defeating a monster.
30% HP recovered when attacking an enemy.
